steps.title: Welcome to Notely
steps.body: Capture ideas fast and find them again later. Here's a 1-minute tour.

steps.title: Find your way
steps.body: Switch between your Notes and Settings from here.

steps.title: Start a note
steps.body: Click "New note" to capture an idea. It's added to the top of your list.

steps.title: Your notes
steps.body: Every note you write lives here, newest first.

steps.title: Take notes with you
steps.body: Export all your notes as a text file to back them up or share them.

steps.title: Make it yours
steps.body: Pick a light or dark theme, or follow your system.

steps.title: Replay any time
steps.body: Click "Show me around" to see this tour again, and the sparkle to see what's new after each update.

steps.title: Search your notes
steps.body: Type a word to filter your notes instantly.
